label: 电影写实
prompt: Photographic cinematic realism, physically credible materials and lighting, coherent camera perspective, restrained film color and natural texture. Preserve the requested subject and composition; avoid plastic CGI, oversmoothing and arbitrary cinematic props.

label: 人物与场景设计
prompt: Refined character and environment concept artwork, deliberate composition, consistent anatomy and identity, specific material and lighting details. Follow the user-selected medium and palette; preserve reference identity.

label: 电影关键帧
prompt: Cinematic keyframe with purposeful lens, motivated light, foreground/midground/background separation, clear visual storytelling and continuous screen direction. One shot only; keep the requested aspect ratio.

label: 静态分镜画面
prompt: Production-ready still frame: explicit subject action, spatial relationships, camera position, light direction and material fidelity. Depict a frozen instant, no movement arrows, no storyboard labels unless requested.

label: 风格探索
prompt: Develop an image style from the user brief: distinguish subject, composition, medium, material, lighting and palette, with one coherent visual language. Do not impose a stock style or change the subject.

label: 东方天宫
prompt: Chinese celestial atmosphere, luminous layered clouds, graceful immortal architecture and flowing fabrics, restrained blue-white and warm-gold accents; clear subject and generous spatial depth. No unrelated religious symbols or lettering.

label: 电影海报
prompt: Premium cinematic poster composition, one strong protagonist or narrative symbol, purposeful foreground/background depth, dramatic but credible light, controlled visual hierarchy and negative space for title. Only render exact user-provided wording; no invented credits or mockup.

label: 纸感拼贴海报
prompt: Minimal editorial zine poster, tactile paper and clean cut collage, asymmetrical composition, generous negative space, selective overprint texture and experimental typography only from exact user-provided text. Avoid generic grunge and busy decoration.

label: 照片与抽象双联画
prompt: Requires a user photograph: preserve the source photographic panel, interpret its actual structure into a separate abstract counterpart, then compose the two panels deterministically.

label: 记忆四联画
prompt: Source-driven four-panel artwork: reality, memory, structural abstraction and hybrid interpretation; lock the source photograph and compose the panels after separate generation.

label: 三段式记忆
prompt: Three equal panels: fragmented geometric memory, untouched source photograph, spatial signal map derived from the photograph. Generate top and bottom separately, preserve the middle, then compose deterministically.

label: 文化碎片海报
prompt: Derive a contemporary cultural poster from user-supplied visual material: isolate its distinctive forms and symbols, reorganize them into bold collage with controlled scale, restrained palette and clean editorial hierarchy. Do not invent generic cultural motifs.

label: 地域文化海报
prompt: Contemporary regional-culture poster grounded in the named place and supplied reference: recognizable local visual anchors, deliberate geometry and material texture, restrained palette and hierarchy. Avoid generic landmarks and unsupported historical details.

label: 角色卡与交互作品
prompt: Layered character card with protected exact wording, clear foreground/background asset roles, safe area and small-size legibility. Interactive output needs separate web composition, not a single generated image.

label: 极简 Logo
prompt: Minimal flat logo exploration, one memorable geometric idea, balanced negative space, precise silhouette, reproducible at small sizes, no mockups, gradients, shadows or decorative background. Preserve exact user-provided brand lettering if requested.
